answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 400 POA bond locked 45 days, so one fake identity costs 400 POA no farm can split. To activate it must finish a kernel proof, a sequential puzzle taking 40 minutes, so a thousand fakes need a thousand runs. Its first ten jobs enter a public relic ledger buyers can read, so copied history shows at once. Two random auditors replay the proof and an early job; a fake proof burns the bond, bars the key for a year, and the crystal ledger keeps the verdict public.
